model_annotation: The plot illustrates the loss over iterations for different models, comparing their performance. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are six lines in the plot, each representing a different model: Vanilla (purple, solid line), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid line), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid line), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid line). All lines start at a high loss value around 3.4 and decrease as the number of iterations increases, with the loss values at the start and end of the x-axis being approximately 3.4 and 2.5 for Vanilla, 3.4 and 2.65 for StrmLLM (n=64), 3.3 and 2.55 for SepLLM (n=64), 3.3 and 2.55 for SepLLM (n=64, H), 3.3 and 2.55 for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and 3.3 and 2.65 for SepLLM (n=128), respectively. The lines exhibit a sharp decline in loss initially, followed by a gradual decrease, with some lines showing a more pronounced decline than others.
